name: chr-line-clf-v2

cnn.input: grey crop of the S1 box padded 4 px, 32 px high, aspect kept, left-aligned on white, 256 px wide
cnn.training: 13,169 labelled GHN lines from 76 spent pages of #2128 (first check, tuning pages, 3.1 and 3.2 gates), 2,278 New Testament-aligned Cherokee lines (GHN silver and aligned training lines, test set v2), 6,000 LoC English lines; fading, blur, brightness and noise augmentation; 4 epochs

chr.text: the #2128 R3 corpus: the 1860 New Testament minus 274 excluded verses, plus ChrEn 2020's Cherokee side
chr.why_not: ChrEn (Zhang, Frey and Bansal, EMNLP 2020) is for research use; rebuild with scripts/ocr-survey/chr2128/r3_corpus.py on branch chr-2128

eng.text: LoC's OCR text of the 324 Phoenix pages, lines outside Cherokee blocks whose words of 3 or more letters are all in /usr/share/dict/american-english

deployment: Used by scripts/ocr-survey/chr_ghn_layout/ghn_boxes.py write for the GHN campaign (#1622).
